header.running_head: Following The Elders Despite Believing Differently

blocks.text: (RA) to teach me a particular verse of the Qur'aan. When he taught it to me in a certain way, I informed him that Hadhrat Umar (RA) had taught it to me in a manner quite different to the way in which he taught it. He then started to weep so much that I saw his tears amongst the pebbles (on the ground). He then said, 'Read it as Umar had read it because I swear by Allaah that his recitation was clearer than that of the people of Saylaheen (a place near Baghdad). Umar was an impregnable fortress of Islaam. Islaam would enter by him but never leave from him. When he was martyred, the fortress was holed and Islaam has come out of the fortress without entering into it."[^1]
Getting Annoyed for the Sake of One's Elders
Hadhrat Umar (RA) is Annoyed by a Man who Insulted Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA)

Hadhrat Shurayh bin Ubayd reports that a man once said to Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA), "What is the matter with you learned men? You are more cowardly than us, most miserly when asked for something and have the largest morsels when you eat!" Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) ignored the man without replying. When the news reached Hadhrat Umar (RA), he asked Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) about it. Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) said, "I seek Allaah's forgiveness. Should we take them to task for everything we hear them say?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) then went to the man who made the remark to Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA). Hadhrat Umar (RA) grabbed him, throttled him and brought him before Rasulullaah ﷺ, where the man pleaded, "We were only talking and joking." It was then that Allaah revealed the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ لَيَقُوْلُنَّ إِنَّمَا كُنَّا نَخُوْضُ وَنَلْعَبُ
blocks.text: If you have to ask them they will (brush it off and falsely) say, "We were only talking and joking (to pass time without intending any harm)."[^2]
Hadhrat Umar (RA) Rebukes and Warns a Person who Regarded him to Be Superior to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)

Hadhrat Jubayr bin Nufayr reports that a group of people once came to Hadhrat Umar (RA) and said, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! We swear by Allaah that we have never seen anyone more just, more outspoken of the truth and more sterner against the Munaafiqeen than yourself. You are certainly the best of people after Rasulullaah ﷺ." Hadhrat Awf bin Maalik (RA) remarked, "You are wrong! By Allaah! We have seen someone better than him after Rasulullaah ﷺ."
